- equals(p1,p2): x equal && y equal.
- intersects(p1,q1,p2,q2): true if (equals(p1,q1)&&equals(p2,q2)) || (equals(p1,q2)&&equals(p2,q1)); else (area(p1,q1,p2,q2)>0) != (area(p1,q1,q2,p2)>0) && (area(p2,q2,p1,q1)>0) != (area(p2,q2,q1,p1)>0).
- pointInTriangle(ax,ay,bx,by,cx,cy,px,py): (cx-px)*(ay-py) >= (ax-px)*(cy-py) && (ax-px)*(by-py) >= (bx-px)*(ay-py) && (bx-px)*(cy-py) >= (cx-px)*(by-py).
- locallyInside(a,b): if area(a.prev,a,a.next)<0 { area(a,b,a.next)>=0 && area(a,a.prev,b)>=0 } else { area(a,b,a.prev)<0 || area(a,a.next,b)<0 }.

- insertNode(i,x,y,last): create node p; if no last: p.prev=p.next=p; else p.next=last.next; p.prev=last; last.next.prev=p; last.next=p; return p.
- removeNode(p): p.next.prev=p.prev; p.prev.next=p.next; if p.prevZ: p.prevZ.nextZ=p.nextZ; if p.nextZ: p.nextZ.prevZ=p.prevZ.
- linkedList(pts, start, end, dim, clockwise): last=None; if clockwise == (signedArea>0) { for i in (start..end).step_by(dim): last=insertNode(i,pts[i],pts[i+1],last) } else { for i in (start..end).step_by(dim).rev(): same }; if last && equals(last, last.next) { removeNode(last); last=last.next }; return last.

- sortLinked(list): Simon Tatham merge sort on the nextZ chain by z ascending, stable. inSize=1; loop { p=list; list=None; tail=None; numMerges=0; while p.is_some() { numMerges++; q=p; pSize=0; for _ in 0..inSize { pSize++; q=q.nextZ; if q none break }; qSize=inSize; while pSize>0 || (qSize>0 && q.is_some()) { if pSize==0 { e=q; q=q.nextZ; qSize-- } else if qSize==0 || q.is_none() { e=p; p=p.nextZ; pSize-- } else if p.z <= q.z { e=p; p=p.nextZ; pSize-- } else { e=q; q=q.nextZ; qSize-- }; if tail: tail.nextZ=e else list=e; e.prevZ=tail; tail=e }; p=q }; tail.nextZ=None; if numMerges<=1 return list; inSize*=2 }.
- isEarHashed(ear): a=ear.prev,b=ear,c=ear.next; if area(a,b,c)>=0 return false; minTX=min(a.x,min(b.x,c.x)); minTY, maxTX, maxTY likewise; minZ=zOrder(minTX,minTY); maxZ=zOrder(maxTX,maxTY); p=ear.nextZ; while p.is_some() && p.z<=maxZ { if p!=ear.prev && p!=ear.next && pointInTriangle(a,b,c,p) && area(p.prev,p,p.next)>=0 return false; p=p.nextZ }; p=ear.prevZ; while p.is_some() && p.z>=minZ { same check }; return true.

- isValidDiagonal(a,b): a.next.i != b.i && a.prev.i != b.i && !intersectsPolygon(a,b) && ((locallyInside(a,b) && locallyInside(b,a) && middleInside(a,b) && (area(a.prev,a,b.prev)!=0.0 || area(a,b.prev,b)!=0.0)) || (equals(a,b) && area(a.prev,a,a.next)!=0.0 && area(b.prev,b,b.next)!=0.0)).
